vulnerable_code:
@router.get("/api/v1/deployments/{deployment_id}/timeline/cursor")
async def stream_deployment_timeline(
    deployment_id: str,
    last_sequence: int = Query(0),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_db),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    async def step_generator():
        stmt = (
            select(DeploymentStepEvent)
            .where(DeploymentStepEvent.deployment_id == deployment_id, DeploymentStepEvent.sequence_num > last_sequence)
            .order_by(DeploymentStepEvent.sequence_num.asc())
            .limit(40)
        )
        res = await db.execute(stmt)
        for ev in res.scalars().all():
            yield json.dumps({"seq": ev.sequence_num, "step": ev.step_name, "status": ev.status}) + "\n"

    return StreamingResponse(step_generator(), media_type="application/x-ndjson")
diagnosis: The async generator streams paginated deployment lifecycle step events by deployment_id without checking whether the deployment belongs to current_user.organization_id. Any user can monitor infrastructure deployment progress and internal build step names of other organizations.
